newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebecor Printing buys AmerSig Graphics.
newsitem.headline: Quebecor Printing buys AmerSig Graphics.

text.p: Quebecor Printing Inc said on Wednesday that it agreed to buy AmerSig Graphics Inc for US$55 million plus the assumption of debt.
The transaction is subject to completion of due diligence reviews and compliance with regulatory requirements, and is expected to be completed on or before November 30.

American Signature specializes in the production of catalogues and magazines and has four plants in Atlanta, Georgia, Lincoln, Nebraska, Dallas, Texas and Olive Branch, Mississippi. The company has about US$230 million of annual revenues and employs 1,600 people.

James Dawson, president and chief executive of Quebecor Printing (USA) Corp, said in a statement that the acquisition will double the amount of state-of-the-art short cut-off high speed presses available to the company's customers.
